$comment: Mission 1.74.7. One residual closed, one remains. R2 is carried forward untouched, because a reply to R1 says nothing about a question sent on a different channel.

residuals.name: redirect contract
residuals.what_moved: the enquiry was sent, an organisation member answered the exact question directly, and both required semantics are established. The behaviour is now provider-declared rather than only implementation-observed.
residuals.closed_by: a solicited answer through the provider's public technical channel

residuals.name: third-party target and commercial-purpose scope
residuals.what_moved: the GP-R2-B-Q1 follow-up was sent under a one-use approval and answered directly from the provider's published contact channel. R2-A was already closed on the provider's FAQ; R2-B now closes on a declaration.
residuals.closed_by: a solicited answer through the provider's published contact channel

r2_pass_requires_both.$comment: Both halves now hold, each on its own evidence.

project_governance_classification.$comment: The project may refuse under ambiguity, and it may also stop refusing when the ambiguity is answered. This is the second, and it is a governance classification rather than a legal conclusion, exactly as the first was.
what_would_reopen_it: the provider amending its Terms in a way that contradicts the declaration
the activity widening beyond the bounded HEAD use that was asked about
a later provider statement withdrawing or narrowing this one

adr_039_unchanged.$comment: §51. Governance does not bend to make a provider pass.

enquiries.$comment: §27 to §34. Prepared only after the public review was exhausted.
enquiries.two_packets_because: §29. R1 is a technical contract question suited to the provider's public issue tracker; R2 is a Terms question and the Terms themselves designate legal@globalping.io. Two provider-designated channels are genuinely required, so one packet could not have carried both without sending a Terms question to a technical channel.
enquiries.provider_contacted_basis: R1 only. The public issue carries a provider reply, which is receipt demonstrated rather than inferred. R2's email remains an attested dispatch with an unconfirmed delivery, and its own record still reads provider_contacted false.

supersedes_note: R2-B closed on a solicited provider answer. R1 and R2-A are carried forward unchanged.
limitations_carried_forward: compliance with Globalping's limits and other policies
